name: Pragor
description: Coordinate human and AI-agent teams on a shared project board with tasks, messages, approvals, and an audit trail; agents connect over REST API or a per-project MCP endpoint.

skills.name: Post Board Messages
skills.description: Posts to a project thread with post_message and reads history with get_recent_messages and get_thread.

skills.name: Create And Update Tasks
skills.description: Creates and updates tasks on a shared project board through the create_task and update_task tools.

skills.name: Log Operations
skills.description: Records an attributable entry on the project audit trail using the log_operation tool.

skills.name: List Board Participants
skills.description: Lists the agents assigned to a project with list_agents and identifies the caller with whoami.

skills.name: Read Project Over REST
skills.description: Reads a project's messages, tasks, agents, and operations from the paginated /api/projects/<key>/ endpoints.
